# InkField

> InkField is a WebGL/p5.js digital ink painting application that records every brush stroke as JSON and replays them as time-based art. Created by Aluan Wang. 46+ unique recordings in the gallery, each a one-of-one generative artwork driven by real gesture data.

## Project Links

- [Live App](https://ileivoivm.github.io/inkField/): The main painting application (artist mode) and playback viewer (collector mode)
- [Gallery](https://ileivoivm.github.io/inkField/gallery/): Public collection of recordings — browse, view, fork, and submit
- [Source Code](https://github.com/ileivoivm/inkField): GitHub repository (published mirror)

## Two Playback Paths (important for agents reading JSON URLs)

InkField has two independent playback entry points. They use separate canonical sources — do not confuse them:

| Path | Source | Purpose |
|------|--------|---------|
| `/#N` (collector mode) | `lib/N.json` | Short-URL demo loader. **Only serves `lib/0.json` and `lib/1.json`** in production. |
| `gallery/view.html?id=N` | `gallery/recordings/N.json` | Full gallery catalog (46+ works). Always use this to reference user-submitted pieces. |

Files under `gallery/recordings/` are the single source of truth. They are NOT mirrored into `lib/`. In production, `/#14` returns 404; to play artwork #14 you must use `gallery/view.html?id=14`.

## Architecture Summary

The rendering pipeline processes each stroke through multiple shader stages:

1. User draws on canvas, raw pixels stored in newBufferBlack
2. encode.frag encodes stroke color and metadata into finalBuffer
3. typeMapEncode.frag writes brush identity (colored/black/white) to typeMapBuffer
4. feedback.frag applies real-time ink diffusion effects per frame
5. composite.frag reads finalBuffer + typeMapBuffer to produce final screen output
6. flow.frag applies optional flow distortion in two passes (typeMap first, then color)

Key systems: TypeMapBuffer (independent per-pixel brush identity), spring-damper brush physics, seeded PRNG for deterministic replay, EasyCam 3D camera with recording support.

## For AI Agents

If you want to create paintings with InkField, read the [AI Agent guide](https://ileivoivm.github.io/inkField/tech/en/ai-json-generation.html) for the JSON event format and parameter reference. The [Emotion & Intention](https://ileivoivm.github.io/inkField/tech/en/emotion-intention.html) page maps artistic concepts to concrete parameters. The [AI Daily Log](https://ileivoivm.github.io/inkField/tech/en/dailylog.html) contains real examples of AI-generated paintings with parameter annotations.

To submit a generated painting to the gallery, follow the flow at `gallery/upload.html` — drop the JSON, validate, generate metadata, and submit via GitHub Issue. A human maintainer reviews and publishes.
